current.generation: Founder POST action create-courtesy-code with raw_code (founder-chosen string, normalized upper/no-space, stored as SHA-256 hash). No random generator.
current.rules: active; redemptions_used < max_redemptions; valid_from <= now; expires_at; eligible_email; eligible_client_id; timing-safe hash compare.
current.overrides: discount_type: PERCENT_100, FULL_CASE_COMP, FIXED_AMOUNT (cents), DIAGNOSIS_ONLY, LABOR_ONLY, SPECIFIC_SERVICE (value cents).
current.waivers: Effectively full comps (PERCENT_100/FULL_CASE_COMP) -> case status COMPLIMENTARY_APPROVED + entitlement {complimentary:true}.
current.client_pricing: Only via eligible_email / eligible_client_id restriction; quotes are per-case founder-authored line items.
current.redemption: completeCheckout(): increments redemptions_used, writes redemption record, audit event COURTESY_CODE_APPLIED; if final total > 0 throws PAYMENT_REQUIRED (no payment provider). previewCourtesyCode for validation.
current.scope: eligible_services column default ['EXISTING_LOCATION'] but validateCourtesyForQuote never checks it; service-specific by construction only.
current.audit: case_events audit() in memory; created_by + founder_note on code; redemptions table (schema).
current.ui: Client: courtesy code input on existing-location checkout. Founder: NONE — API only; SITE00_ROUTES.existingLocationAdmin constant has no mounted admin route/page.
current.persistence_note: Service uses in-memory Maps (api/_lib/existingLocation/memoryStore.ts); no code reads/writes site00_courtesy_* tables. Codes vanish on Railway restart.

gaps: No general promotion engine: courtesy codes are hard-wired to EXISTING_LOCATION quotes; eligible_services stored but never enforced.
Courtesy persistence is in-memory despite tables existing — redemption limits and audit not durable; multi-instance would double-redeem.
No founder management UI (list/create/deactivate/redemption history) — only raw POST API.
No code generation (random/unique), no bulk/campaign codes, no per-code stacking rules, no min-spend, no currency scope.
No project credits / stored value / prepaid generation credits ledger.
No client-specific pricing overrides or price book; quotes are ad hoc line items.
No usage-limit enforcement tied to billing (usageMetering NOT_AVAILABLE).
No unified audit trail for commercial adjustments (who granted what, why, against which project).
Payment provider absent -> any non-zero final total blocks checkout (PAYMENT_REQUIRED).

recommendation.engine: CONTROL PLANE: a project-agnostic Commercial Adjustments engine (shared/site00-commercial-adjustments + api/_lib) generalizing courtesy.ts: adjustment types (DISCOUNT_PERCENT, DISCOUNT_FIXED, COMP/WAIVER, PROJECT_CREDIT, PRICE_OVERRIDE, USAGE_LIMIT_OVERRIDE), scope (service/package/project/client/identity), eligibility, validity window, max redemptions, stacking policy, Supabase-persisted (reuse/extend site00_courtesy_codes + site00_courtesy_redemptions into site00_commercial_adjustments + site00_adjustment_applications + append-only audit), enforced server-side at quote/checkout/entitlement resolution for every service (Existing Location, BLDR, IDNTY, EVOLVE). Credits as a ledger table with balances derived.
recommendation.founder_surface: FOUNDER CONTROL ROOM > COMMERCIAL: create/deactivate codes, grant per-client pricing or project credits, set waivers, view redemptions + audit. Project-specific application (e.g. 'comp this case') appears in-context inside project management, but the policy objects and history live in Founder Control Room. Client Control Room shows only the client's own redemptions/credits/receipts.
